dependencies.name: postgres
dependencies.reason: No PostgreSQL in the cluster and the application fails fast on Flyway/datasource; deployed a verification-only quay.io/sclorg/postgresql-16-c9s instance (Service postgres:5432, db postgresDB) with credentials from Secret coolstore-db, created out of band. Production target remains a managed/shared PostgreSQL.

dependencies.name: kafka
dependencies.reason: mp.messaging.incoming.orders and outgoing.orders-out have health-enabled=true, so /q/health/ready is DOWN without a broker; deployed a verification-only single-node KRaft bitnamilegacy/kafka:3.9.0 (Service kafka-bootstrap:9092, topic orders auto-created). Production target remains AMQ Streams.

dependencies.name: keycloak
dependencies.reason: OIDC_ENABLED=false (backend bearer protection is opt-in); the SPA bootstrap document is generated from configuration and no Keycloak call happens at startup. A Keycloak route exists in the cluster if SSO is enabled later.

dependencies.name: audit-collector
dependencies.reason: No NDJSON/TCP collector at audit-collector:9000; the audit logger is asynchronous, delivery failures are logged and do not fail a checkout. AUDIT_ENABLED=false is the switch for such environments.
